note: Create a Character System 3.14.5: KawaiiPhysics in place of the Bonamik on Cloud (Rebirth, PC0000_00: also every skin and swap that wears his model) and Remake Cloud (FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE's PC0000_00, /Game/GameContents/...: the Remake Cloud skin's model), from the Rebirth preset (tools/make_kawaii_preset.py): his 44 hair strands a node each (the settings tuned on Young Sephiroth, each strand a little off them so no two swing as one; his head, neck, back and shoulder pads as colliders, measured from his model), and his trousers' 32 flaps (the Bonamik's Bottom_L / Bottom_R: two bones each on the thighs and calves) in four nodes, a little sway held near the animation, kept out of his legs. The model's Bonamik (PC0000_00_BNM: hair and trousers) is taken off the model as it loads; his KineDriver (PC0000_00_KDI: the knees', elbows' and shoulders' helper bones, none of the physics bones) stays. Needs the game mod 3.14.5.
